vulnerabilities.name: Business Logic Flaw: Cart manipulation / price override
vulnerabilities.description: Business logic vulnerability: Cart manipulation / price override
vulnerabilities.evidence: Scenario steps: GET /cart/add?id=1&qty=1 -> POST /cart/update with negative price -> GET /checkout -> Verify total reflects manipulated price

vulnerabilities.name: Business Logic Flaw: Race condition on coupon application
vulnerabilities.description: Business logic vulnerability: Race condition on coupon application
vulnerabilities.evidence: Scenario steps: POST /coupon/apply (concurrent x10) -> GET /cart (check if coupon applied multiple times) -> POST /checkout -> Verify duplicate discount

vulnerabilities.name: Business Logic Flaw: Mass assignment / privilege escalation
vulnerabilities.description: Business logic vulnerability: Mass assignment / privilege escalation
vulnerabilities.evidence: Scenario steps: POST /api/user/profile with 'role=admin' field -> POST /api/user/update with 'is_admin=true' -> Check 200 vs 403

vulnerabilities.name: Business Logic Flaw: Payment bypass / negative quantity
vulnerabilities.description: Business logic vulnerability: Payment bypass / negative quantity
vulnerabilities.evidence: Scenario steps: POST /cart/add with negative quantity -> POST /checkout -> Verify total is negative -> Attempt checkout with negative balance

vulnerabilities.name: Business Logic Flaw: OAuth token reuse / CSRF bypass
vulnerabilities.description: Business logic vulnerability: OAuth token reuse / CSRF bypass
vulnerabilities.evidence: Scenario steps: Capture OAuth callback token -> Replay from different IP/UA -> Check session creation -> Privilege escalation if admin

vulnerabilities.name: Business Logic Flaw: 2FA bypass via direct API call
vulnerabilities.description: Business logic vulnerability: 2FA bypass via direct API call
vulnerabilities.evidence: Scenario steps: POST /api/login with credentials -> Skip /api/verify call -> Directly call /api/profile -> Check if authenticated

vulnerabilities.name: Business Logic Flaw: IDOR via sequential parameter guessing
vulnerabilities.description: Business logic vulnerability: IDOR via sequential parameter guessing
vulnerabilities.evidence: Scenario steps: GET /api/order/1 -> GET /api/order/2 -> GET /api/order/100 -> Check if other users' orders are accessible
